name: systeme.io
description: All-in-one funnel builder and marketing platform (funnels, email, courses) with a public REST API for contacts, tags, funnels and sales.
access_notes: API keys are generated self-serve from account Settings > 'MCP & API keys' (up to 3 keys, optional expiration; leave expiration empty to keep a key active indefinitely). systeme.io offers a free plan, so credentials are obtainable at no cost. The only documented auth is the X-API-Key header; no OAuth yet.
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server at https://mcp.systeme.io/mcp?mcpKey=... (MCP keys generated in account settings), documented in official help pages and developer.systeme.io/docs/mcp-server; covers contacts, tags, custom fields, newsletters, funnels, price plans, coupons and automation rules. No Composio toolkit for systeme.io found in the docs.composio.dev toolkit catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Webhook support not confirmed from official docs (third-party aggregators claim webhooks exist, but I did not verify a page on developer.systeme.io). API surface is narrower than big marketing suites (contacts/tags/funnels/newsletters/sales); some sources say certain features were initially plan-gated. Whether every API endpoint is available on the free plan was not verified from an official pricing/docs page.

evidence.note: Public API docs: RESTful API at api.systeme.io, 'your only option right now is to attach your API key to the X-API-Key header'
API keys created self-serve under Settings > MCP & API keys; up to 3 keys per account; expiration optional (leave empty for indefinite)
